calls.title: 1:1 Product Research
calls.summary: Johnny Martinez is improving his understanding of product analytics and integrating well with the team, following an initial period of feeling overwhelmed. Kari Kay is working closely with him, offering to connect him with product experts to enhance his onboarding experience. They discussed the importance of guiding non-data scientists in interpreting experiment results to avoid premature actions based on insufficient data. Kari encouraged Johnny to identify pain points in the product experience, aiming for improved usability in future sessions. Additionally, a structured research approach was outlined to balance depth and breadth in user insights, emphasizing the observation of user navigation to inform product enhancements. Effective team communication and collaboration were highlighted as crucial for supporting product goals.
calls.keywords: experiment interpretation, product analytics, non-data scientists, data visibility, user workflow, product onboarding
calls.action_items:
**Johnny Martinez**
Continue engaging with the product to build deeper understanding and respond promptly to team inquiries (06:47)

**Kari Kay**
Facilitate introduction to product experts for Johnny when necessary to aid his learning process (07:26)
Consider organizing a detailed session with the team to explore handling of experiment results by non-data scientists, including example workflows and common issues (04:59)
